decisions.reason: The current FAQ state does not mention the Aave connector or yield generation, so removing Aave requires no FAQ-state change.
Removing the Aave connector does not change the current or planned product names.
The prize payout mode remains automatic wallet transfer and does not depend on the removed Aave connector.
Aave removal does not alter the number or recipient selection of tickets for no-referral mints.
Aave removal does not change no-referral commission amount, trigger, or recipient selection.
Chainlink VRF winner selection is independent of the removed Aave yield connector.
Removing Aave does not change the selected Base blockchain network.
The coded-referral commission amount, recipient, timing, and wallet destination remain unchanged.
Aave removal does not affect which book access, referral identity, badges, or tickets follow an NFT transfer.
The NFT token serial and its display locations remain the referral identity regardless of Aave integration.
The Transak provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, and deferred lifecycle are unrelated to Aave removal.
Removing the Aave connector does not change the royalty amount, enforcement, disclosure, or contribution to prize pools.
